claim: A single NVLink/PCIe path badly under-utilises intra-node GPU-GPU bandwidth; striping messages across multiple NVLink channels, memory regions and GPU streams raises UCX bandwidth 1.69x (72 -> ~122 GB/s) and Open MPI+UCX 1.84x (up to 134 GB/s).
stance_target: multi-path striping recovers bandwidth left idle by single-path transfers
scope_conditions: 4x V100 32GB on IBM POWER9 AC922 (Mist, SciNet), three intra-socket NVLinks
quoted_support: Our approach achieves 1.69x and 1.84x higher bandwidth for UCX and Open MPI + UCX, respectively.

claim: A 3-stage hierarchical, pipelined MPI_Allreduce that uses multi-path NVLink intra-socket and PCIe/X-Bus inter-socket beats NCCL by 1.38x at 1 GB messages and 1.25x at 64 MB.
stance_target: NCCL is not a hard ceiling on an intra-node PCIe/NVLink fabric
scope_conditions: single node, 4x V100, messages 512 KB-1 GB
quoted_support: We outperform Spectrum MPI, Open MPI + UCX, MVAPICH2-GDR, and NCCL at 1GB messages by 12.25x, 15.63x, 1.47x, and 1.38x, respectively.

claim: At 64 MB the hierarchical allreduce beats Spectrum MPI, Open MPI+UCX, Open MPI+HPC-X, MVAPICH2-GDR and NCCL by 11.47x, 14.33x, 1.09x, 1.26x and 1.25x respectively.
stance_target: hierarchical path selection beats single-algorithm collectives at large messages
quoted_support: The proposed algorithm outperforms Spectrum MPI, Open MPI + UCX, Open MPI + HPC-X, MVAPICH2-GDR, and NCCL with a speedup of 11.47x, 14.33x, 1.09x, 1.26x, 1.25x, respectively, for 64MB messages.

claim: The hierarchical allreduce outperforms NCCL for all message sizes greater than 8 MB.
stance_target: NCCL's advantage is confined to small/medium messages on this topology
quoted_support: It also outperforms Open MPI + HPC-X for all message sizes and NCCL for message sizes greater than 8MB.

claim: At the application layer with Horovod+TensorFlow, VGG16 gains up to 3.24x over NCCL and ResNet50 1.23x over NCCL.
stance_target: collective-level gains survive into real DL training loops
quoted_support: For Horovod with TensorFlow and VGG16, we observe up to 2.98x, 3.42x, 3.22x, 1.23x, and 3.24x speedup over Spectrum MPI, Open MPI + UCX, Open MPI + HPC-X, MVAPICH2-GDR, and NCCL, respectively. For ResNet50, we achieve 1.50x, 1.57x, 1.22x, 1.24x, 1.23x speedup over these MPI libraries, respectively.

claim: PCIe Gen4 and the POWER9 X-Bus are both ~32 GB/s, so on an NVLink-X-Bus-NVLink inter-socket path the X-Bus is the bottleneck and PCIe-X-Bus-PCIe can be the better choice for some message sizes.
stance_target: path selection must account for the slowest hop, not just the fastest link
scope_conditions: IBM AC922 topology: NVLink 25 GB/s, X-Bus 32 GB/s, PCIe Gen4 32 GB/s
quoted_support: we use the PCIe-X-Bus-PCIe path for certain message sizes. We observed that for each message size, different

claim: The inter-socket stage is the bottleneck: PCIe Gen4 performs the same as the X-Bus for that stage, so the choice between NVLink-X-Bus-NVLink and PCIe-X-Bus-PCIe matters per message size.
stance_target: how to route inter-socket traffic when no direct GPU-GPU link exists
quoted_support: between NVLink and X-Bus, the bottleneck is the X-Bus, and that the performance of PCIe Gen4 is the same as X-Bus

claim: The structural lesson for a no-P2P box: every collective round-trips through host RAM, so using ALL available paths (including host X-bus staging) rather than one at a time is the lever.
stance_target: hierarchical/multi-path collectives are the right design for a PCIe-only no-P2P fabric
scope_conditions: intra-node collectives without direct GPU-GPU links
quoted_support: We propose a novel data transfer mechanism that stripes the message across multiple intra-socket communication channels and multiple memory regions using multiple GPU streams to utilise all available NVLink paths.

claim: The mechanism is dated (2021, V100, NCCL 2.5.6, Open MPI 4.0.4rc2, UCX 1.8.0), so absolute speedups against modern NCCL should not be assumed.
stance_target: recency of the measured NCCL comparison
scope_conditions: software stack: NCCL 2.5.6, UCX 1.8.0, Open MPI 4.0.4rc2, Horovod 0.20.3
quoted_support: For our studies, we have used Open MPI 4.0.4rc2 with UCX 1.8.0, Open MPI + HPC-X (with UCX and HCOLL) from HPC-X v2.7, Spectrum-MPI 10.3.1, MVAPICH2-GDR 2.3.5, NCCL 2.5.6, and Horovod 0.20.3 with TensorFlow 1.15.2.

stance_target: applicability of the multi-path result to a Gen2 x4 no-NVLink box
